title: Great way to store right over the door!
text: Great way to store right over the door!. Just what I needed!  My shoes were all over the floor so I came to Amazon for an over the door shoe holder.  This was a perfect solution.  The mesh holders are wonderful because my shoes can breath after Im done wearing them and it fits right over the door, easy assembly.  Each pocket fits a shoe.  I love it!

product_metadata.title: MISSLO Door Shoe Organizer Hanging with 24 Large Mesh Pockets Shoe Hanger Organizer for Door, Tan
features: 24 roomy clear see through mesh pockets organizes up to 12 pairs of men size 13 shoes;
Perfect door pockets organizer for holding shoes, sneaker, bathroom, pantry, kitchen and cleaning supplies, toys and barbie dolls and accessories;
The shoe door rack could easily be cut in half horizontally, and can be fold very small for travel storage;
4 over the door hooks included, the maximum width of door that fits the hook is 1.65 inches, home door fitted, also wall mount by other ways;
Dimensions: 56 1/2"L x 22 1/3"W, each pocket measure 5 2/5" in width and 7 4/5" in height.
